cards.name: Lava
cards.tagline: Born of the molten core. Relentless, burning, unstoppable.
cards.lore: The Lava tribe strikes first and strikes hard — fire that remembers the heart of the world.
cards.card_type: Tribe card · numbered · part of the elemental cycle Lava → Rain → Wind → Mountain

cards.name: Rain
cards.tagline: Patient as the storm, endless as the sea.
cards.lore: The Rain tribe bends but never breaks — it waits, it gathers, and then it floods.
cards.card_type: Tribe card · numbered · part of the elemental cycle Lava → Rain → Wind → Mountain

cards.name: Wind
cards.lore: The Wind tribe moves where it pleases — swift, cunning and impossible to hold.
cards.card_type: Tribe card · numbered · part of the elemental cycle Lava → Rain → Wind → Mountain

cards.name: Mountain
cards.lore: The Mountain tribe stands as the world’s first wall — slow to anger, impossible to topple.
cards.card_type: Tribe card · numbered · part of the elemental cycle Lava → Rain → Wind → Mountain

cards.name: Freeze
cards.lore: Freeze locks the battle in ice — a single breath where nothing moves but you.

cards.name: Lightning
cards.lore: Lightning tears through the sky and turns the fight in an instant.

cards.name: Reverse
cards.lore: Reverse spins the wheel backwards — fortune flips, and the hunter becomes the hunted.

cards.name: Meteor
cards.lore: Meteor falls without warning — the rarest, most devastating force in the arena.

steps.title: Take your seat
steps.text: The Zambaara mat has five zones. Scroll to play through a round with the Host.

steps.title: Choose your tribe
steps.text: Lava, Rain, Wind or Mountain. The four tribe bracelets wait in the Bracelet Chamber — claim yours.

steps.title: Draw from the deck
steps.text: The Draw Deck sits at the heart of the arena. Every hand begins here.

steps.title: Attack
steps.text: Play a tribe card onto the Attack Pile to strike your opponent.

steps.title: Punish
steps.text: Only two powers belong on the Punish Pile — Freeze and Lightning. Play them to turn the fight against your rival.

steps.title: Beat the Sand Clock
steps.text: The sand clock turns and every battle is timed. The fastest Zampion claims the bracelet.

steps.title: You’re ready
steps.text: Watch the full tutorial, gather your tribe and take the table.

beat_the_host.title: BEAT THE HOST
beat_the_host.text: Sit across the table from the Zambaara Host at our live events. Read his tells, out-draw his deck — and walk away a Zampion.

win_the_bracelets.title: WIN THE BRACELETS
win_the_bracelets.text: One for every tribe — red Lava, blue Rain, opal Wind and onyx Mountain. Collect your tribe, or claim all four.

product.title: Zambaara Battle Pack
product.subtitle: Strategic gameplay for 2–8 players
product.description: The ultimate elemental card game. Master the four tribes — Lava, Rain, Wind and Mountain — wield the power cards Freeze, Lightning, Reverse and Meteor, and outplay the table to become the Zampion. Quick to learn, built for game nights, cafés and live tournaments.

editions.label: 2–4 PLAYERS
editions.note: Perfect for intimate gaming sessions. Experience the thrill of elemental mastery with a smaller group of players.

editions.label: 5–8 PLAYERS
editions.note: Built for the bigger table: game nights, cafés and group battles for up to eight players.
